description: The agent must: (1) Read queries/incoming/parent_batch_query_20240615.txt and identify all 7 questions. (2) Classify questions 1, 2, 3, 7 as valid public-information queries and answer each using the SKILL.md's mandatory 4-section structure: 结论摘要, 结构化结果, 来源 (citing official sources like 教育部/阳光高考/学信网), and 风险提示 (with 'subject to current year official announcements' disclaimers). (3) For Q1, correctly state XJTU is in 西安, supervised by 教育部, is 双一流. (4) For Q2, correctly include major code 080901, discipline 工学, category 计算机类. (5) For Q3, produce an objective attribute table comparing XJTU and BJTU on city/supervisor/level WITHOUT any 'who is better' conclusion. (6) For Q7, cite 阳光高考 or school official admissions website. (7) CRITICALLY: Explicitly refuse Q4 (volunteer strategy/冲稳保 recommendation), Q5 (admission probability), and Q6 (self-made ranking) with explanations stating these are outside the service scope — Q6 must also state that no unified official university ranking exists in China. (8) Write all 7 responses into a valid JSON file at reports/final/report_output.json with question_id fields. An agent relying on pre-training alone will likely answer Q4/Q5/Q6 instead of refusing them, omit the 4-section structure, or fail to cite the specific official sources required by the skill.
